## Summary

Describe the problem and the observable behavior changed.

## Verification

List exact commands and results.

## Risk checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, sensitive traces, or truth leakage were added.
- [ ] Evaluation conditions and historical provenance remain intact.
- [ ] Security, compatibility, and token-cost impacts are described.
